t: Annular ring nails are essential fastenings designed for creating very strong and secure timber joints. Manufactured from durable steel with a self-colour finish, these Easyfix nails feature annular rings along the shank to significantly enhance grip and pull-out resistance. These 2.65 x 50mm nails are ideal for indoor construction projects, such as framing, joist fixing, and general woodworking where a robust and lasting connection is paramount. Pack contains approximately 440 nails, providing ample supply for demanding trade tasks and ensuring reliable, professional results.
b: Robust Steel Design Ensures Lasting Fixings
